calls.title: PepsiCo - Growth Book connect
calls.summary: The meeting covered the launch of GrowthBook's product analytics in GA version 5.0 three weeks ago, including features like behavioral tracking, A/B testing, and customer segmentation. Upcoming enhancements include a session replay feature for better insights on user behavior, expected to release within a month at no extra cost. The GrowthBook SDK offers flexible data capture options, supporting both turnkey setups and experiment-only analyses. Experiment guardrails and metrics management are now integrated with automated rollback features. The roadmap aims for further innovations by year-end, focusing on real-time experimentation and seamless integrations, particularly with Slack and Teams based on client feedback.
calls.keywords: Product Analytics, GrowthBook SDK, Session Replay, Experimentation, Guardrails, Auto Tracking
